title: terrain/tiles.json, terrain_low/tiles.json
description: Design contracts v1 (family 'design', DESIGN §6; frozen at merge: additive change = minor bump, breaking change = human-gated). Metadata of the U1 elevation tiles (terrain/, z10-15 planning extent + z16 focus area, 1 m merged DEM with 20 m CTX at low zoom, budget config/design.yaml terrain_tiles.budget_mb 25) and of the intro relief tiles (terrain_low/, z6-10 over Gale, CTX 20 m + MOLA-HRSC 200 m, budget lowzoom_budget_mb 5). Tiles: 256 px PNG, XYZ scheme (Mars lon/lat straight through, D4), Terrarium encoding: h = (R*256 + G + B/256) - 32768 m, with h = true elevation * factor + vertical_offset_m (factor = Earth/Mars radius 1.878, so 1x exaggeration on screen is true shape; vertical_offset_m, optional, default 0, puts the site near 0 m on the map). True elevation = (h - vertical_offset_m) / factor; elevation readouts never come from these tiles (they come from the fields). Written by pipeline/export/terrain_tiles.py and relief_lowzoom.py (WS16).
x-source: DESIGN §6.1, §2.2 U1, U6 step 3; config/design.yaml scale, terrain_tiles

factor.description: elevation multiplier baked into the tiles (config scale.elevation_factor = 1.878); also in the manifest

vertical_offset_m.description: optional (P2c, additive, contract 1.1.0): metres added to every tile height after scaling, h = true elevation * factor + vertical_offset_m (config terrain_tiles.vertical_offset_m; the same value in terrain/ and terrain_low/; absent = 0); also in the manifest

datum.description: optional: vertical datum of the true elevation (e.g. Mars 2000 areoid)

tiles.description: URL templates relative to the data root, e.g. terrain/{z}/{x}/{y}.png; the app prefixes its data base URL

maxzoom.description: highest zoom written anywhere (terrain: the focus zoom 16)

bounds.description: [w, s, e, n] lon/lat deg tiled at every zoom from minzoom to the zoom below focus.minzoom (all zooms when focus is null)
[w, s, e, n] lon/lat deg of the focus area

focus.description: zooms tiled over the focus area only (terrain: z16, config zooms_focus_area); null when none (terrain_low). A client that wants no 404s uses one source for minzoom..focus.minzoom-1 with bounds and one for the focus zooms with focus.bounds

source.description: input elevation products, finest first (e.g. data/interim/terrain/dem_1m.tif, CTX 20 m DTM, MOLA-HRSC 200 m)

source_hash.description: sha256 (hex, full or first 16+) over the source files in source order; also in the manifest

total_bytes.description: sum of all tile file sizes, bytes

budget_bytes.description: optional: the budget the writer enforced (config budget_mb * 2^20); total_bytes <= budget_bytes

tile_count.description: optional: zoom level (string) -> number of tiles written

attribution.description: optional: credit line for the elevation sources
